title: Sticky Molasses Barbecue Sauce
summary: Ketchup simmered with molasses, brown sugar, cider vinegar, mustard and chilli into a thick, sticky glaze, then blended smooth.

ingredients.item: small onion, very finely chopped or grated

steps.title: Soften the aromatics
steps.text: Melt the butter in the saucepan over medium heat. Cook the onion for about 5 min until soft, then stir in the garlic for 30 s.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.text: Add the ketchup, molasses, sugar, vinegar, mustard, chilli powder, cayenne and pepper. Bring to the boil, then lower the heat and simmer for 20-25 min, stirring often so it does not catch, until slightly thicker.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blitz the sauce until completely smooth with a stick blender or in a blender.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Let it cool. Brush onto chicken during the last 10 min of grilling or roasting, turning once, and serve extra sauce on the side.

tips: Brush on late; the sugar burns if it goes on too early.
Add more cayenne for heat or a little more vinegar for tang.
Keep a separate portion for serving that has not touched raw meat.
Use a splatter guard; thick sauce spits as it simmers.
storage: Keep in a clean jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
